<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>

# Check all nodes in detail
seg = current_frame.segmentation
print(f"Total nodes: {len(seg['nodes'])}")

# Group by color
from collections import defaultdict
by_color = defaultdict(list)
for n in seg['nodes']:
    by_color[n['color']].append(n)

for color, nodes in sorted(by_color.items()):
    total_pixels = sum(n['pixels'] for n in nodes)
    print(f"  {color}: {len(nodes)} nodes, {total_pixels} pixels")

# Check W nodes (white)
W_nodes = by_color.get('W', [])
print(f"\nWhite nodes: {len(W_nodes)}")
for n in W_nodes:
    b = n['boundary']
    rows = [p[0] for p in b]
    cols = [p[1] for p in b]
    cr, cc = sum(rows)//len(rows), sum(cols)//len(cols)
    print(f"  White at ({cr}, {cc}), pixels={n['pixels']}, boundary={b[:4]}...")

# Check w nodes (light gray)
w_nodes = by_color.get('w', [])
print(f"\nLight gray nodes: {len(w_nodes)}")

# Try clicking a white tile if it exists in the grid
if W_nodes:
    # Find white tile that's in the grid (not in bar)
    for n in W_nodes:
        b = n['boundary']
        min_row = min(p[0] for p in b)
        if min_row > 5:  # Not in bar area
            cr, cc = sum(p[0] for p in b)//len(b), sum(p[1] for p in b)//len(b)
            print(f"\nClicking white tile at ({cr}, {cc})")
            result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': cr, 'col': cc}])
            
            seg = current_frame.segmentation
            colors = {}
            for n in seg['nodes']:
                c = n['color']
                colors[c] = colors.get(c, 0) + 1
            print(f"Colors after: {colors}")
            
            ascii_lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
            bar = ascii_lines[0]
            print(f"Bar w count: {bar.count('w')}")
            print(f"Game over: {last_action_result.get('game_over')}")
            print(f"Level completed: {last_action_result.get('level_completed')}")
            break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
